maria: Heads up — after onboarding checkpoint v2.1 + tokenizer v3 the staging p99 jumped from ~180ms to ~380ms. Reproducible on the STG pool.
ajay: can you paste the perf profile you took?
maria: pasted below. noticed kernel selection flips to generic matmul for long prefixes and a lot of KV cache evictions.

maria: ```
summary: p50 45ms p95 125ms p99 380ms
hotpath: attention -> matmul_generic (falling back from optimized_attention)
kv_cache_evictions: 12/s (previously 0.3/s)
notes: tokenizer now emits an extra <BOS> token and different token length distribution (avg input len +14%)
```

sam: ci-bot reported a perf failure on the staging-bench job: https://ci.internal/runs/8142 — looks correlated.
ci-bot: [job 8142] PERF_FAILURE: p99 latency increased by 110%. See artifacts: /artifacts/8142/profile.pb

ajay: interesting — new tokenizer shifting tokenization could bump effective sequence length which changes kernel selection heuristics. did we update the kernel selection thresholds with tokenizer change?
maria: not intentionally. the onboard manifest pulled tokenizer v3 by PR #4621. PR diff: changed tokenization rules for punctuation -> more subwords.

kevin: ran a quick reproducer locally with the same payloads. when we force kernel selection to prefer optimized_attention the p99 returns to ~170ms.
kevin: quick command I used: `XLA_KERNEL_FORCE=optimized_attention ./run_staging_repro --checkpoint v2.1 --tokens 256`

sam: looks like two factors: (1) tokenizer increases avg seq len, (2) kernel chooser uses a seq-length bucket that now selects generic kernels for more requests. also KV cache eviction rate spikes because more unique prefixes -> smaller reuse.

olivia: rollout hold on v2.1? current Dedicated smoke is stable but staging shows regression. recommend blocking further ramp until root cause triaged. :warning:
maria: +1. Can we bisect to the specific change? I ran git-bisect across the onboarding PRs and landed on commit 3f4b2a1 in the tokenization transform.

sam: commit 3f4b2a1 looks like the token merging tweak. It increased subword splitting near punctuation. Patch here: https://git.internal/r/redwood/repo/+/3f4b2a1

ajay: if that's the cause, two short fixes: (A) pin tokenizer to v2 in the onboard manifest (hot revert), (B) change kernel selector to be more robust (move threshold +10% seq len) as a short-term mitigation.

kevin: I can cut a hotfix PR to pin tokenizer and put a guard in runtime to compute effective_seq_estimate = max(estimated, observed_kv_cache_avg_seq) before choosing kernels. small runtime change may be riskier but doable.

maria: preference for pin first (lowest blast radius). then we can roll forward with a runtime tweak and more thorough perf testing.

olivia: created rollout blocker ticket RB-2024 and added docs for the hold.
perf-bot: Created issue PERF-723: "Staging p99 spike after tokenizer v3 onboarding" (link: https://issues/internal/723)

sam: CI note: we should add tokenization distribution checks to the onboarding pipeline. a small unit: run representative prompts and assert avg token length delta < 8%.
ajay: Agreed. I'll add a gating job to onboard pipeline and a perf test that uses the staging-bench harness.

maria: action items:
- kevin: open hotfix PR to pin tokenizer in manifest (assign kevin)
- ajay: add gating perf check to onboarding CI (assign ajay)
- sam: follow up on bisect and verify perf-bot traces (assign sam)
- olivia: keep rollout hold until fix + validation (assign olivia)

kevin: opening PR now: https://git.internal/r/redwood/repo/+/PR-4789 pin tokenizer v2 for v2.1 onboarding. hope to cut revert today.
maria: thanks. once PR merges can someone re-run the staging-bench job and confirm p99 back to baseline?
sam: I'll do a re-run after PR lands and post results here.

kevin: PR merged. rolling staging job back to v2.0 tokenizer.
ci-bot: [job 8150] DEPLOY: onboard manifest updated (PR-4789).

sam: re-run complete — p99 175ms, kv evictions down to 0.4/s. baseline restored.
maria: great. leaving the blocker open until we add the onboarding gate and a runtime protective change.

olivia: noted — keeping hold and follow-ups in the ticket. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone. we'll plan a controlled re-onboard after perf tests plus a runtime selector patch.

ajay: FYI for followup: consider tuning batching heuristics too — more subword granularity can increase token churn inside batches which affects throughput.

maria: noted. will include batching tests in the perf checklist.

kevins: (reaction) :rocket:
